name: You Saved Me
source:
*Coming Soon*


"You saved me" visual novel presents the story of Ayden, the main protagonist and his group of 5 friends (Adam, Chris, Henry, Damian, Diana), who lived their whole life in the small town of Hiraeth Creek.

After a while, since they haven't hung out together they decided now is the time to rekindle their relationship bonds in the last month of high school. Being together again like in the good old times, Ayden slowly begins to realize the underneath problems inside his group and will try to uncover the truth about his friends and town that hides in the shadows.

Ayden knows that he can't continue to just observe and let things happen, he feels that now is time to act...before is too late. Will the outsider observer go straight into the center of the storm? 

Unknown to them, this will trigger a series of events: old conflicts reignite and once again shake up the group as it did in the past, new dramas, inner conflicts torment their minds. 

Will they face their deepest fears and emotions just to survive the greatest unknown mystery of their lives? Will they ...once and for all...stand together this time against it? To a threat that will change their lives forever...

Choose your path wisely...
translation:
*即将推出*


视觉小说《You Saved Me》讲述了主人公艾登，以及亚当、克里斯、亨利、达米安、戴安娜这5位朋友的故事。他们一直生活在Hiraeth Creek这座小镇。

众人已有一阵子没有相聚，于是决定在高中最后一个月，重新拉近彼此的关系。再次像过去那样聚在一起后，艾登逐渐察觉到团体内部潜藏的问题，并试图揭开朋友们与这座小镇隐藏在阴影中的真相。

艾登明白，自己不能继续旁观，任由事情发生。他觉得，现在是时候行动了……必须赶在一切太迟之前。这个局外的观察者，会径直走进风暴中心吗？

他们并不知道，这将引发一连串事件。旧日冲突再度燃起，如过去那样动摇整个团体，新的纠葛与内心挣扎，也不断折磨着他们。

为了熬过人生中最难以捉摸的谜团，他们能否直面心底最深的恐惧与情感？这一次，他们能否……真正团结起来……共同面对那场将永远改变人生的威胁？

请慎重选择自己的道路……
